steps.en: Install the package and set an LLM provider key
steps.zh: 安装包，配好一个 LLM 提供方的 key

steps.en: Create a LangGraph store with an embedding index
steps.zh: 建一个带 embedding 索引的 LangGraph 存储

steps.en: Give your agent the two memory tools
steps.zh: 把两件记忆工具交给你的 agent

steps.en: Mid-chat, the model decides a fact is worth keeping and writes or updates it in the store
steps.zh: 对话中模型判断某条事实值得留下，写入或更新到存储

steps.en: In a later conversation, it searches the namespace by meaning and answers from what it recalls
steps.zh: 之后的对话里按语义检索该命名空间，用找回的记忆作答

value.en: Your LangGraph agent remembers users across threads without you writing extraction prompts or storage code
value.zh: 你的 LangGraph agent 跨线程记得用户，而不用你自己写抽取提示词和存储代码

sources: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langmem README (main @ 2026-10-08): Installation `pip install -U langmem`, API key env; Creating an Agent: InMemoryStore(index={dims, embed}), AsyncPostgresStore note, create_manage_memory_tool / create_search_memory_tool with namespace=("memories",); usage notes on agent deciding what to store and searching later
